purpose: Teach: アドベンチャー/ヒルトン/ハーレム/エイリアン/ゴルファー/トークショー/東映/バイエルン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アドベンチャーゲームばっかやってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were totally glued to adventure games back then.
lines.style: Warm tease, light and casual. Eyes bright with old-memory amusement. Leans in slightly like she's about to get him back for something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヒルトンホテルでお祝いされたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one getting celebrated at that fancy Hilton party, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan deflection with a smile underneath. Throws it back at her without missing a beat. Relaxed shoulder shrug — comfortable in the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハーレム漫画読んでただろ
lines.en: Riku, you were totally reading harem manga back in the day.
lines.style: Caught-you tone, playful jab. Raises an eyebrow like she's found his weakness. Quick and sharp — the rhythm of someone enjoying the game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エイリアンの映画怖がってたな、桜
lines.en: And you were the one who freaked out at that Alien movie, remember?
lines.style: Laughing comeback, light mockery. Draws out the memory like it's obvious and funny. Quick cadence — landing the punch before moving on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、プロゴルファー目指してたな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you the one who wanted to be a pro golfer?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity underneath the teasing. Softer attack than the others — less jab, more wondering-aloud. Slight tilt of the head like she's actually curious where that went.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トークショーの真似してたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one doing talk show impressions, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact callback with quiet fondness. Not defensive — just stating fact. Slight smile in the voice. Steady, unbothered rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、東映特撮シリーズハマってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were absolutely obsessed with those Toei tokusatsu shows.
lines.style: Affectionate observation, slightly sing-song rhythm. Nostalgic tone — remembering something she watched him care about. Warm and teasing at once.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、バイエルンのユニフォーム着てたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one parading around in that Bayern Munich jersey, weren't you?
lines.style: Final callback, gentle and close. Softer attack than before — warmth breaking through the teasing. Slight laugh in the voice, intimate knowing.
